title: Assistant Resident Engineer | PATH
description:
Title:
Assistant Resident Engineer | PATH

Client:
The Assistant Resident Engineer will work for our client, a leading civil engineering firm, established in 1999 and recently voted as one of the Top 25 Engineering firms by NJ Biz. This firm has steadily grown based on a solid reputation for providing quality service. The diverse staff includes a team of respected engineers and inspectors throughout New Jersey and New York. Efforts include some of the largest transportation projects in the NY Metro area such as the Raising of the Bayonne Bridge, Tappan Zee Hudson River Crossing, NJ Turnpike Widening, and Fulton Street Transit Center.

Description:
Reporting to the Engineer of Construction for PATH, our client is searching for an Assistant Resident Engineer to supervise and manage the day-to-day activities as it relates to Engineering/Construction Management and Administrative/Financial matters. Projects include building construction, rail, concrete work, paving, with some electrical, structural, mechanical, plumbing, environmental and finishes knowledge. Inspection services on projects mainly involve electrical, electronics, electrical substations, high tension work, A/C utility service, security and camera systems, fire alarm monitoring systems, fire suppression systems, building management systems, intercom systems, and radio systems.

Responsibilities:
  • Knowledge and familiarity of Contract documents
  • Ensure construction is performed in accordance with contract drawings
  • Ensure that construction is performed in accordance with specifications and all appropriate codes
  • Review and evaluate potential items of extra work
  • Provide justification and cost estimates of extra work
  • Complete daily narrative and daily labor reports
  • Schedule and conduct site inspections as required
  • The ARE shall keep the Resident Engineer informed on all discrepancies and differing field conditions
Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering
  • Minimum of ten (10) years or more of construction management and inspection experience
  • Minimum of five (5) years or more inspecting construction work
  • Construction experience should primarily consist of concrete, reinforced steel, asphalt paving, drainage, and building construction
  • Excellent communication skills a MUST (with contractors, engineering staff and Resident Engineer)
  • Valid driver’s license
  • Must have a 30-hour OSHA construction safety certification
  • Other certs desired Fall Protection, confined space, and work zone safety
  • Ability to pass a SWAC background check
  • Competent in Microsoft Office
  • PE License or RA PREFERRED but not required.
Education:
Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Mechanical or Civil/Structural Engineering required

title: Intermediate – Senior level Electrical Engineer | NYC Housing Authority
description:
Job Title:
Intermediate – Senior level Electrical Engineer | NYC Housing Authority

Firm Description:
Our client provides professional, technical and management support services to public and private sector clients. Although launched as an independent company in 1990, our client's history can be traced back to the early 20th century. Through a series of acquisitions and technological developments, their expansion included petrochemical, highway construction, transportation design, facilities construction, and construction materials firms. They use their extensive knowledge in planning, designing, and managing transportation systems to restore and replace aging infrastructure across cities, countries and continents. Recent projects include a new subway line in New York City, the world's largest green-field port development in Qatar, a 24-kilometer sea crossing in Malaysia and the expansion of LA International Airport.

Job Description:
Our client is seeking to hire a Licensed Electrical Engineer (either intermediate or Senior-level) to work on NYCHA projects, specifically multiple ongoing Electrical Design Engineering projects involving Electrical Design from “Pre-Design through “Closeout activities”. This is a full-time 40-hour position at NYCHA’s LIC offices. This is a twelve-month project that is expected to be renewed every year for the foreseeable future. (with a slight possibility of going permanent).

Responsibilities:
  • Prepare all electrical contract documents for new and existing housing development.
  • Perform engineering judgements throughout all the assigned projects.
  • Preparation of electrical layout, lighting design, wiring, riser diagrams, security systems and analysis using AutoCAD.
  • Field investigations and report writing.
Required:
  • Proven experience with multi-family residential projects of various scales.
  • Familiar with NYC engineering design standards, codes, and industry standards relevant to engineering design.
  • Design of electrical power systems, service room layout, site lighting, and security, load calculations, fire alarm systems and lighting.
  • Familiar with contract documents for engineering and construction phases.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD. Revit is desirable.
  • Must be licensed.
  • Great communications skills. Ability to work as part of a team.
Education:
BS in Electrical Engineering or similar
MUST be licensed.

title: Architect | Aviation Design
description:
Architect | Aviation Design (Temporary)
Location: New York, NY (Full-Time, In-Person)
Duration: Through December
Software: Rhino (preferred), Revit (required)
Client: International Architecture & Design Firm

Overview:
Our client, a globally recognized architecture and design firm known for delivering large-scale, high-profile, and technically complex projects, is seeking an Architect to support their aviation design team on a temporary basis through December. This role will contribute to the design development (DD) package for both architectural and interiors scopes.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with the design team on the development of architectural and interior design packages.

  • Depending on experience, responsibilities may include building envelope, canopies, interior fit-outs, restrooms, or finish packages.

  • Produce high-quality design documentation using Rhino and Revit.

  • Coordinate with multiple disciplines in a fast-paced design environment.

Ideal Candidate Will Have:

  • Experience working in design development phases on large, complex projects.

  • Proficiency in Revit is required.

  • Previous aviation project experience is not required, but familiarity with large infrastructure or transportation projects is helpful.

  • Ability to contribute to a team working at the intersection of architecture and interior design.

Work Environment:

  • Full-time, onsite in the client’s New York City office.

  • Collaborative, fast-paced studio environment within a global design practice.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-caliber team on a landmark aviation project and gain experience at one of the world’s top design firms.

title: Senior Interior Architect / Project Manager | Hospitality
description:
Senior Interior Architect / Project Manager | Hospitality, F&B, Retail, Senior Living

Our client, a global design studio with an award-winning portfolio, is seeking a Senior Interior Architect / Project Manager to lead both the design and technical development of hospitality, F&B, retail, and senior living projects. This role combines creative leadership with strong project management skills — ensuring design excellence, financial performance, and on-time delivery from concept through construction.

The ideal candidate is not only a design leader but also a business-minded project manager who understands how to make a project profitable, oversee budgets and deliverables, and manage projects holistically.

Responsibilities

  • Lead design and technical development of hospitality, F&B, retail, and senior living projects

  • Translate design concepts into cohesive architectural solutions and detailed documentation

  • Oversee project budgets, schedules, deliverables, and overall financial performance

  • Create construction drawings, millwork details, and design presentations

  • Coordinate with consultants, vendors, and contractors to maintain design integrity

  • Manage client relationships and project communications

  • Mentor and oversee junior designers and architectural staff

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in architecture or interior architecture, with a focus on hospitality, F&B, or retail

  • Proven experience managing project budgets, schedules, and profitability

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture or Interior Architecture

  • Strong knowledge of building codes, universal access guidelines, and building systems

  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, Adobe Creative Suite, Bluebeam, and 3D modeling/rendering software (SketchUp, Rhino, V-Ray, etc.); Revit experience is a plus

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and client management skills

  • Based in the Tri-State area with U.S. work eligibility

Compensation & Benefits

  • 95-110k

  • Health, dental & vision insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Paid time off

  • Hybrid schedule (3 days in-office per week)

This is an excellent opportunity for a detail-oriented, solution-driven professional who thrives in a dual role — driving design innovation while ensuring projects are delivered profitably, on schedule, and to the highest quality standards.

title: Senior Electrical Engineer | Facilities Group – Life Sciences, Science & Technology, Infrastructure,
description:
Title:
Senior Electrical Engineer | Facilities Group – Life Sciences, Science & Technology, Infrastructure, Commercial projects

Client:
For over sixty years, our client has provided essential engineering services for many of the great public and private building projects of our time, ranging from high-rise office towers and corporate headquarters to universities and libraries, hospitals, airports, and the public sector. It is their dedication and vision coupled with their technical capabilities, that bring together so many owners, architects, developers, and facilities managers, who rely upon them to help their projects succeed.

Job Description:
Immediate need for an experienced Electrical Engineer with 7 – 10 years of experience and a proven interest in building design and sound knowledge of electrical engineering fundamentals. Attendance in-office 5 days/week. Option for 1 remote day after starting.

Responsibilities:
  • Design power distribution, lighting, fire alarm and telecommunications plans including all associated circuitry, details, one-line diagrams and specifications.
  • Perform system design calculations, load calculations, arc flash and fault current, lighting, and any other calculations required to support electrical design.
  • Prepare electrical construction documents including drawings, specifications, and reports for an assortment of buildings including science and technology, infrastructure upgrades, laboratory design, and commercial buildings.
  • Ensure design is consistent with the overall vision and design schedules are maintained.
  • Work closely with the client and other design team members, including owners, architects, and contractors.
  • Selection and specification of appropriate equipment
  • Attend meetings and communicate with clients to establish their needs and discuss design issues.
Job Requirements:
  • Seven to ten (7-10) years professional experience in designing Electrical Systems for life sciences, science and technology, infrastructure upgrades, labs, commercial buildings working with AE or MEP consulting firms.
  • Strong AutoCAD capabilities, Revit is a plus.
  • PE License is preferred but not required.
  • Strong understanding of the NEC and the International Building Codes
  • Ability to multi-task with multiple projects to meet strict deadlines.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and in writing
Education:
Bachelors in Electrical Engineering
